rules: Every mandatory Genesis requirement must have implementation evidence, one or more later qualification/remediation owners, one or more AC-1 through AC-10 mappings, a required-test path, and required evidence.
Required-view requirements must trace to dedicated EXP-0.3.2 implementation paths and EXP-0.3.3 acceptance-test maps.
Non-view mandatory requirements may use acceptance-criterion verification methods as their required later test path when no dedicated view test map applies.
Every Genesis-blocking finding must trace backward to at least one affected requirement, at least one remediation milestone, its acceptance criteria, and required evidence.
Every finding→requirement reference must be reciprocated by the requirement's blocking_finding_refs.
The governance scope conflict is traceable but remains unresolved; EXP-FIND-001 must route to EXP-0.3.8 and continue blocking final EXP-0 closeout.
Traceability completeness does not mean findings are resolved or acceptance criteria are satisfied.
